# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release with several behavioral changes from the m132/m147/m148 Skia upgrade — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **New SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default** — new SKFont().Typeface used to resolve to the platform default at draw time; it now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing draws. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null** — SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent and return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null** — Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete** — The overload used to silently truncate out-of-range offsets to a native 32-bit int. It now throws OverflowException for out-of-range values and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls a fatal native abort — not a catchable exception — when the instance/device version is below 1.1. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its unsafe default of 0). Vulkan-1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to another backend. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout and identity changed** — The struct gained a new Components field (backed by GRVkYcbcrComponents), and GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, losing value-equality (Equals/== / != are gone). Code that manually builds the struct or compares instances for equality must be updated. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its public setter** — The property is now get-only from outside the type. Remove any external assignment to it. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Engine

- **Skia bumped through m132, m133, m147, to m148** — Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m148 upstream release line, the basis for this v4 line, plus the ongoing chrome/m147 upstream bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts** — Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette selection, with improved variable font robustness. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — SKWebpEncoder can now encode animated WebP images, and SKStream.GetData() converts a stream to SKData without an extra copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on surface drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions to control filtering when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzz HBColor and API cleanup** — Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes across the binding. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Legacy pre-v4 obsoletes promoted to compile errors** — Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs (legacy paint text/font state, and other trimmed obsolete enum members) now fail to compile instead of just warning, completing the v3-to-v4 migration path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access corrected** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis (Width, not Height) for the (x, y) overload's offset, fixing incorrect pixel reads. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Fixes a crash when the SKPathBuilder backing an SKPath is collected before the path itself. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default-typeface resolution moved to managed code** — Fixes a null-typeface crash on newer Android by resolving the default typeface in the managed layer instead of relying on the native platform path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Android SKGLView rendering after tab switch** — Fixes SKGLView failing to render again after switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Apple and WinUI packaging fixes** — Corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps) and fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL for .NET 9 consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native targets added** — Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM Emscripten floor raised** — Drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat, HarfBuzz, libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest versions. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t along with variable font shaping support, and bumps the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
